doc.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Red Callender, a name already
summary: Hamilton notes that Red Callender was already established, and that they later worked together on staff at Paramount Studios.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Did you know Red at this point as well, Red Callender?
Yeah, I did. Red and I worked quite a bit together. As a matter of fact, Red Callender, and myself, and Dudley Brooks, piano player, we were on staff at Paramount Studios. This was later.
Yeah, this is much later, okay. We jumped way ahead now.

Yeah. Strangely enough man, I had no idea Red was as young as he was, but Red was already a name, you know. He was working with everybody, all the places. But I guess from 16 on, that’s when I was making my living playing. That’s all I was doing.
